comparison.objective: Release a captive multistage bayonet sleeve through a spring-loaded internal track and rotational reversal, then place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained push/rotate/reverse manipulation and removal against spring/contact geometry; no hammer-and-mandrel impact or small-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Released stationary sleeve earns partial credit; full success requires it in the parts tray with 20 s hands-off. Exact alignment, damage, and force limits are not stated.
comparison.reason: Both culminate in recovered hardware, but this tests reversible bayonet-track extraction of one sleeve, not fracture of four notched tangs while retaining surrounding coils.
